svg.text: A100 · atom DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23, dense attention over all N atoms) · training · d 128, cond 128, pair 16, 4 heads × 32, transition n = 2, bf16
forward (saves the AdaLN statistics and gates, qkvg, o, lse, the bias, y, g2, the transition's activations)
ĉ = LN(cond) · γ; [s | b] = ĉ [Ws | Wsh]ᵀ + [bs | 0]
xa = sigmoid(s) · LN(x) + b # statistics, gate saved
F2 · q | k | v | g projection
cuBLAS · 1 GEMM (the four weights packed once per version)
[q | k | v | g] = xa [Wq; Wk; Wv; Wg]ᵀ + [bq, 0, 0, 0]
s = q kᵀ / √32 + bias; o = softmax(s) v
lse = log₂ Σ exp₂(s) # per sample, head, query
og = sigmoid(g) · o; y = og @ Woᵀ; g2 = cond @ Wscᵀ + bsc
x1 = x + sigmoid(g2) · y # one row pass
ab = xt [Wa | Wb]ᵀ; h = silu(a) · b; z = h Wsᵀ
out = x1 + sigmoid(cond Wsc'ᵀ + b) · z
single, cond, out, xa, xt, o, og, y, g2, x1, z
backward; the attention kernels read the saved bias, lse and the row term D = Σ dO · O; the bias gradient leaves as bf16 partials of 4 samples
dz = sigmoid(·) gate backward; dh = dz Ws; dWs = dzᵀ h
dab = swiglu'(ab) · dh; dxt = dab [Wa | Wb]; dWab = dabᵀ xt
dscale = dxt · x̂ · gate (1 − gate); dĉ = [dscale | dxt] [Ws; Wsh]
dx1 = LN-bwd(dxt · gate); dcond, dγ = LN-bwd(dĉ)
B3 · residual gate, output projection, attention gate
dy = dx1 · sigmoid(g2); dg2 = dx1 · y · sigmoid'(g2)
dog = dy @ Wo; dWo = dyᵀ og
do = sigmoid(g) · dog; dg = dog · o · sigmoid'(g)
D = Σ_d do · o; P = exp₂(s − lse); dP = do vᵀ
dS = P (dP − D); dq = dS k; dbias partials = Σ4 samples dS
db = Σ partials # fixed order, bf16 → fp32
dv = Pᵀ do; dk = dSᵀ q
dxh = Σ_h db[h] W'[h]; dz = rstd (dxh − mean dxh − x̂ mean(dxh x̂))
dW'[h, c] = Σ_ij db[h] x̂[c] # per-block partials, fixed order
B7 · projections, conditioning gate, AdaLN backward
cuBLAS · 4 GEMMs, Triton AdaLN backward as B2
dxa = [dq | dk | dv | dg] Wqkvg; dWqkvg = [dq | dk | dv | dg]ᵀ xa
dcond += dg2 Wsc; dWsc = dg2ᵀ cond
dsingle = dx1 + AdaLN-bwd(dxa); dcond (all the contributions)
do, dy, dg2, dx1, dxt, dsingle, dcond
dqkvg (dq | dk | dv written in place, dg beside them)
